ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows an unfolded rectangular blackboard, divided by two vertical dividing lines into three sections: left, middle, and right. The length label at the top shows that the total length after the whole board is unfolded is 6 m. The middle section at the bottom is labeled 3 m, and a question mark is marked below the right outer section. In the picture, the left and right outer panels are drawn as mutually corresponding matching outer panels, so according to the meaning of the picture, take their lengths to be equal. Reasoning: The total length is 6 m, and the middle part is 3 m, so the two left and right outer parts together are 6 - 3 = 3 m. Since the left and right outer parts are equal, the length of each side is 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5 m. Therefore the length of the right part represented by the question mark is 1.5 m.

raw_record.question_text: A blackboard has a total unfolded length of $6 \mathrm{~m}$. The middle section is $3 \mathrm{~m}$ long. How long is the section labelled with a question mark?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a straight unfolded blackboard divided into three vertical sections: left side, middle section, and right side marked with '?'. From the text, take the total unfolded length as 6 m and the middle section as 3 m. From the image, note that the left and right side sections are drawn as matching outer panels, so they have equal length. Subtract the middle length from the total: 6 - 3 = 3 m remains for the two equal side sections. Divide by 2 to get the unknown right section: 3/2 = 1.5 m.
